title: OCEANCRAFT 3D — Deep Sea Fishing & Hydrodynamics Studio
description: A complete, production-ready, 100% client-side 3D fishing game and hydrodynamics playground built with vanilla HTML5, CSS3, ES6 and Three.js r128. Dynamic wave field, sampled boat buoyancy, cast-and-reel tension minigame, 18-species aquarium logbook, gear upgrades, Web Audio soundscape, localStorage autosave and JSON save transfer.

build.note: Start is the OpenCode session creation time; completion is the build-state snapshot. The final state commit, GitHub push and Pages verification happen immediately after this snapshot.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record at packaging time. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are context-usage figures listed separately. Final commit/push verification happens after this snapshot, so live session totals are marginally higher.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.

game.ocean: 380 x 380 displaced PlaneGeometry (up to 112 x 112 segments), five-component sine/cosine wave field, procedural normal map, vertex colouring, foam and sun glints
game.physics: four-point hull sampling -> damped vertical buoyancy, bow pitch and side roll
game.catchRecords: weight (kg), length (cm), rarity, weather, reward and timestamp; per-species bests plus heaviest/longest/rarest
game.audio: Web Audio API only: brown-noise ocean bed, reel clicks, splashes, bite, surge, snap, escape, thunder and catch chimes
game.visuals: procedural boat, lighthouse island, buoys, birds, clouds, sun/moon, 1,200 stars, bioluminescent plankton, rain and lightning
game.responsive: desktop, tablet and 390 x 844 mobile layouts; mobile view pad (zoom +/- , move mode, recenter), pinch/two-finger gestures and a collapsible rig panel
controls: hold Cast / Space / C to charge; release to cast
hold Reel / R / Space during a fight
drag / scroll to orbit and zoom
L logbook, M mute, ? help, Esc close

notes: No image, texture, 3D model or audio assets are used; boat, lighthouse, fish, particles, sky and soundscape are generated at runtime.
The project directory follows the OceanCraft brief in this session. The existing cyberdoom-retro-fps project is a separate build.

postBuild.summary: Mobile scene-camera controls: pinch-to-zoom, two-finger pan, one-finger orbit/move mode, dedicated view pad (zoom in/out, move, recenter), and a collapsible fishing panel. Mobile camera target raised so the boat sits above the info panel by default.
